title: Add Agno boundary, no-fake-runtime diagnostics, and contract coverage
verify: Agno output/events/memory cannot bypass project-owned validation, permission, observation, trace, or publication contracts.
Diagnostics/OpenAPI expose redacted trace summaries without secrets or hidden reasoning.
evidence_required: Negative tests for separate ungoverned harness entrypoints and Agno bypass attempts.
Generated OpenAPI validation after schemas exist.
constraints: Agno is optional execution layer only, not source of truth, Bus replacement, domain coordinator, or hidden memory authority.
Runtime/demo acceptance cannot use fake, mock, hardcoded, or stubbed product-agent outputs.
invariants: Separate ungoverned product-agent harnesses are absent.
T3 closure requires /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, human checkpoint, and rollback/recovery note.
